feature: Per-attempt actual model request and response in conversation detail

SSE reply shows ordered events, combined output and complete flag
Historical call explicitly shows payload unavailable

privacy: Only reaction/reply JSON bodies retained; no HTTP auth headers/audio

Privacy-off blocks future payload capture, including off-to-on midcall

limitations: Existing records have no recoverable model payloads
Sudden process termination may leave request without returned data
